digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Tuesday, September 1, with 11 timed calendar blocks, three urgent priorities, six carried-over items, and no active reminders. The day turns on validating the Amazon Connect routing fix during the final UAT window, resolving the Sprint 17 capacity tradeoff before the 2:00 PM EPMO catch-up, and assigning coverage for the 10:30 AM, 1:00 PM, and 4:00 PM collisions. Amazon UAT reached 21%; the language-setting fix may remove a major routing failure, but it still needs retesting before defects close. Dashboard state was last modified Friday, so completion status may not reflect changes made since then.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect UAT recovery decision
items.detail: Recorded completion reached 21%, and the language-setting defect that blocked calls for users without the English skill was reported fixed. Retest the affected scenarios, close or assign remaining defects, and use the 4:00 PM final working session to set the recovery recommendation.

items.label: Prioritize Licelot's Quality project portfolio
items.detail: The Quality review surfaced five requests spanning declarations, cross-client data issues, wrong-client escalation, Team Lead suspensions, and Intake Attorney task-set work. Rank the requests by business impact and set one intake path with realistic PM and PE capacity.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect migration-list gaps
items.detail: Confirm the remaining leaders, preserve the N/A plus Reporting guidance for non-calling users, and lock the production provisioning list before UAT findings become migration blockers.

items.label: Limpiar Asana con el spreadsheet de Armando
items.detail: Use the noon protected block to reconcile Armando's spreadsheet against Asana, close stale entries, and leave one current operating view before the afternoon meeting run.

items.label: Decide Eduanny Suero's SOP access request
items.detail: Confirm the business need and appropriate permission for the Travel Permit client-contact SOP, then approve or decline the outstanding SharePoint request.

items.label: Clear the stalled Sales and Revenue Cloud dependencies
items.detail: Confirm the Revenue Cloud owner, bring Deepak and Tim into the Sales Cloud work, secure an invoice record in sandbox, and set firm due dates at the next portfolio checkpoint.

items.label: 10:30-11:00 AM - Jhara 1:1 conflicts with SVC standup
items.detail: Choose the live priority and capture coverage for the other. The SVC session is the first checkpoint for validating yesterday's Amazon routing fix.

items.label: 11:00 AM-noon - Required self-review training
items.detail: The English live session overlaps the first half-hour of slide focus time. Attend this session or deliberately select one of the alternate mandatory sessions.

items.label: Noon-1:00 PM - Protected work block
items.detail: Use the only clean focus window for the migration list, Asana reconciliation, and the Sprint 17 decision brief.

items.label: 1:00-2:00 PM - Knowledge Management and Case Management overlap
items.detail: Assign coverage before noon. The Knowledge Management discussion needs alignment on why a PM is required and what the role should own.

items.label: 2:00-4:00 PM - EPMO leadership and Nicolas follow-through
items.detail: Bring a clear Sprint 17 recommendation, portfolio risks, and named dependency owners into the EPMO catch-up and the 3:30 PM Nicolas 1:1.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Amazon UAT final session conflicts with CSC portfolio review
items.detail: Choose coverage in advance. The UAT block is the final defect-submission window, while the CSC review needs initial portfolio priorities and risks captured.

items.label: Resolve the Sprint 17 capacity tradeoff
items.detail: Anu confirmed the sprint cannot absorb both the ready CoE stories and Biographical deadline work. Review Mar's requested project summaries, decide what moves, and give the team a priority answer before the 2:00 PM EPMO catch-up.

items.label: Clarify Licelot's Staff Aug document access and next step
items.detail: Licelot reported that the shared Object-fields workbook is inaccessible and asked what action is expected. Restore access or route it to the owner, then answer the action-item question.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Thiago 1:1 conflicts with SVC standup
items.detail: Decide whether the UAT follow-through needs the focused 1:1 or the broader standup, and assign coverage for the other.

items.label: 2:00 PM - EPMO Team Meeting conflicts with English self-review training
items.detail: If today's training is missed, tomorrow's English session overlaps the team meeting; the Spanish morning session remains the cleaner alternative.

items.label: 3:30-4:30 PM - Portfolio and CoE collisions
items.detail: Legal portfolio review overlaps the Laura 1:1 at 3:30 PM, followed by a 4:00 PM CoE touchpoint that competes with meeting-prep focus time.
